verdicts.reason: A breaks the frame: a grey slab fills the top fifth while the side borders disappear. The poodle is oversized and jammed against the left edge, and the bone sits off-axis in the bottom-left corner, touching the edge. B keeps the grey-bordered white card and a centred axis, but the bone is blown up into a huge pixelated blob that rivals the poodle. The headline wraps into six cramped lines with an awkward 'THE DOG / BAR' break, so it reads weaker than the icons.
